svg.title: Exercise, a GLP-1 drug, or both: the S-LiTE trial
svg.desc: S-LiTE trial, 195 adults with obesity who first lost 13.1 kg on an 8-week diet. During the treatment year, compared with placebo: exercise kept off 4.1 kg more, liraglutide 6.8 kg more, and exercise plus liraglutide 9.5 kg more. In the year after treatment stopped, 109 people came back: those who had exercised regained 3.6 kg, liraglutide alone 9.6 kg, and the combination 7.1 kg.

svg.text: Cardio, a GLP-1 drug, or both? A year-long trial tested it
